messages.content: 一個1公斤的冰塊在0°C被加熱到100°C，在1大氣壓下，其熵變化為多少焦耳/開氏度？

function.name: entropy_change_calculate
function.description: Calculate the change in entropy for a mass of a specific substance under set initial and final conditions. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

substance.description: The substance for which the change in entropy is calculated.

mass.description: The mass of the substance in kg.

initial_temperature.description: The initial temperature of the substance in degree Celsius.

final_temperature.description: The final temperature of the substance in degree Celsius.

pressure.description: The pressure the substance is under in atmospheres.

message.content:
**答案：** 約 **2.5 kJ / K**（即約 **2 525 J / K**）。 --- ### 計算過程（以可逆過程為基礎） | 步驟 | 變化 | 熵變公式 | 數值 | |------|------|----------|------| | 1. 冰 → 水（0 °C） | 相變 | \(\displaystyle \Delta S_{\text{melt}}=\frac{L_f}{T}\) | \(L_f\approx 333.55\;\text{kJ kg}^{-1}\)，\(T=273.15\;\text{K}\) → \(\Delta S_{\text{melt}}\approx 1.22\;\text{kJ kg}^{-1}\text{K}^{-1}\) | | 2. 水加熱（0 °C → 100 °C） | 加熱 | \(\displaystyle \Delta S_{\text{heat}}=\int_{T_1}^{T_2}\frac{C_p\,dT}{T}\) | 取 \(C_p\approx 4.18\;\text{kJ kg}^{-1}\text{K}^{-1}\)（水的平均比熱）
\(\Delta S_{\text{heat}}\approx C_p\ln\!\left(\frac{T_2}{T_1}\right)=4.18\ln\!\left(\frac{373.15}{273.15}\right)\approx 1.30\;\text{kJ kg}^{-1}\text{K}^{-1}\) | **總熵變** \[ \Delta S_{\text{total}}=\Delta S_{\text{melt}}+\Delta S_{\text{heat}} \approx 1.22+1.30=2.52\;\text{kJ kg}^{-1}\text{K}^{-1} \] 換算成焦耳/開氏度（J/K）： \[ 2.52\;\text{kJ kg}^{-1}\text{K}^{-1}=2\,520\;\text{J kg}^{-1}\text{K}^{-1}\approx 2\,525\;\text{J kg}^{-1}\text{K}^{-1} \] --- > **結論**：將 1 kg 的冰從 0 °C 加熱至 100 °C（在 1 atm 下）所產生的熵變約為 **2 525 J / K**。

Also maybe vaporization? But question says heated to 100°C, not boiled. So final state is liquid water at 100°C. So we need ΔS = ∫ dQ_rev/T. For reversible processes: melting at constant T=273.15 K, ΔS_melt = L_f / T. L_f for ice ~ 333.55 kJ/kg. So ΔS_melt = 333.55 kJ/kg / 273.15 K = 1.220 kJ/(kg·K). Then heating water from 273.15 K to 373.15 K: ΔS_heat = ∫ C_p dT / T. Use average Cp ~ 4.18 kJ/(kg·K) for water. So ΔS_heat ≈ C_p ln(T2/T1) = 4.18 kJ/kg * ln(373.15/273.15). Compute ln ratio: 373.15/273.15 = 1.366. ln = 0.312. Multiply: 4.18*0.312 = 1.305 kJ/(kg·K). Sum: 1.220 + 1.305 = 2.525 kJ/(kg·K). Convert to J/K: 2525 J/(kg·K). The question asks "焦耳/開氏度" which is J/K. So answer: about 2525 J/K.
